__comment: Canonical tako_agent wire fixture for the generated docs/TOOLS.md samples (spec: 2026-08-26-model-facing-surface-redesign, 'TOOLS.md output rendering'). Shape mirrors GET /api/v1/agent/answer/runs/{run_id} as the backend sends it. Deliberately small — 1 card, 3 citations, one entry per metadata list. It KEEPS the fields the projection drops (card methodologies and metric_definitions, content nulls and export_pricing, citation source_name/excerpt/publish_date nulls, run_id, status, request_id) so regenerating exercises the drop path. `timed_out` is absent because it no longer exists: it was MCP-synthetic, never on the wire, and was deleted with the `onTimeout: "return"` arm that was its only producer. The real dropped fields are far larger, 3,232 and 2,070 chars on one staging card. Regenerating TOOLS.md runs this through the real projection + renderer; do not hand-edit the samples there.

result.answer:
Surf Air Mobility grew revenue fastest among the screened US airline companies from 2022 to 2025, with a three-year CAGR of 73.9% [1]. Global Crossing Airlines Group ranked second at 36.4% [1].

Among larger scheduled carriers, Alaska Air Group led at 13.9% CAGR, with revenue rising from $9.6 billion to $14.2 billion [1]. United Airlines Holdings followed at 9.4%, and Delta Air Lines at 8.5% [1]. Coverage of the 2025 filing season is still incomplete for smaller charter operators [3].

The ranking uses revenue CAGR, calculated as (2025 revenue / 2022 revenue)^(1/3) - 1, over the 21 US-headquartered companies with normalized revenue for both endpoint years [1].

cards.title: Fastest US Airline Revenue Growth
cards.description: Three-year revenue CAGR for US-headquartered companies in Tako's Airlines industry, 2022 to 2025, top 10 of 21 screened. Normalized financials, which may differ from as-reported figures.

metric_definitions.name: Revenues (Normalized)
metric_definitions.definition: Excel Formula: IQ_REV Revenues [112] is a line item in the Standard template with the following components: Accident and Health Premiums Earned [118] Asset Management Fee [120] ... This metric is normalized by S&P Global.

citations.title: Regional carriers lag the majors on 2025 revenue recovery
Alaska Air Group reports full-year 2025 results

definitions.definition: Compound annual growth rate: the constant annual rate that would produce the observed change between the beginning and ending revenue over the stated period.
Revenue standardized across companies to improve comparability; it may differ from the exact figures reported in a company's filings.

assumptions.title: Interpretation of "last three years"
assumptions.description: The comparison treats the latest three-year window as calendar 2022 through calendar 2025, using the two endpoint years and three annual growth intervals.

methodology.title: Ranking method
methodology.description: Companies were ranked by three-year revenue CAGR between calendar 2022 and calendar 2025, rather than by absolute dollar growth.

methodology.title: Coverage and scope
methodology.description: The screen included 21 US-headquartered companies classified broadly as airlines, including passenger, cargo, regional, charter, and other operators. Only companies with revenue observations for both endpoint years were ranked.
